statement:
∀ (a b t : ℝ),
  (↑a - ↑b * Complex.I) / 2 * Complex.exp (↑t * Complex.I) +
      (↑a + ↑b * Complex.I) / 2 * Complex.exp (↑(-t) * Complex.I) =
    ↑(a * cos t + b * sin t)

goal.text:
(↑a - ↑b * Complex.I) / 2 * Complex.exp (↑t * Complex.I) + (↑a + ↑b * Complex.I) / 2 * Complex.exp (↑(-t) * Complex.I) =
  ↑(a * cos t + b * sin t)
goal.lhs: (↑a - ↑b * Complex.I) / 2 * Complex.exp (↑t * Complex.I) + (↑a + ↑b * Complex.I) / 2 * Complex.exp (↑(-t) * Complex.I)
